name: sumi
description: UX/UI design mastery plugin — 26 skills, 33 commands (30 numbered steps + 3 utility) across 7 phases (GROUND → DISCOVER → SHAPE → AUDIT → BUILD → VALIDATE → LAUNCH). Each step carries a phase.step address (0.1–6.5) grounded in NNG methodology, Double Diamond, IDEO, and Lean UX. Ordered steps /01 through /30 guide users through the complete product design lifecycle. Commands: /01-ground, /02-brief, /03-research, /04-taste, /05-benchmark, /06-measure, /07-inspo, /08-map, /09-wireframe, /10-vision, /11-anatomy, /12-audit, /13-think, /14-access, /15-flow, /16-expose, /17-tokens, /18-screen, /19-ship, /20-generate, /21-assets, /22-test, /23-roast, /24-remix, /25-qa, /26-verdict, /27-grade, /28-preflight, /29-welcome, /30-iterate, /guide, /next, /status. Covers user research, information architecture, wireframing, visual design mastery (36+ designers, 70 rules, Awwwards scoring), platform standards (iOS 26, M3 Expressive, CSS 2025-2026, 9 device types), AI design generation (Stitch MCP, Fal.ai, Recraft V3, Veo 3.1), UI pattern intelligence (200+ patterns, 50+ benchmarks), usability testing, design QA, pre-launch checklist, post-launch iteration, production code (React/SwiftUI/CSS), Figma MCP, WCAG 2.2+3.0, and 20+ industry verticals.
